Title: Log in with a sample account
Steps: 1. Open http://localhost:3000  2. Click Asha  3. Click Log in
Expected result: Records screen opens, 24 sample records listed, status pill shows "All changes synced"

Title: Wrong password is rejected
Steps: 1. Enter asha@syncsafe.test with password wrong123  2. Log in
Expected result: Red message "Wrong email or password"; stays on login screen

Title: Register a new account
Steps: 1. Click "Create an account"  2. Enter name, new email, 6+ char password  3. Create
Expected result: Logged in as the new user; sees the team's records

Title: Create a record online
Steps: 1. + New record  2. Title "Test pump"  3. Save
Expected result: Record appears with "Synced" tag within 2 s; visible on a second device after Sync now

Title: Empty title is blocked
Steps: 1. + New record  2. Leave title empty, fill notes  3. Save
Expected result: Save is blocked; nothing added to the outbox

Title: Search and filter
Steps: 1. Type "bridge" in search  2. Choose status Follow-up
Expected result: Only matching records shown; count line updates

Title: App opens with no network
Steps: 1. Stop the server (Ctrl+C) or turn Wi-Fi off  2. Reload the page
Expected result: App loads from cache; records still listed; orange offline banner

Title: Offline edits survive a reload
Steps: 1. Create a record and edit another  2. Reload the page
Expected result: Both changes still shown with "Not synced" tag

Title: Changes are queued in the outbox
Steps: 1. Make 2 changes  2. Open Sync activity
Expected result: Outbox table lists 2 operations with type, record and changed fields

Title: Offline banner appears
Steps: 1. Tick Simulate offline (or DevTools Network Offline)
Expected result: Banner "You are offline" and pill "Offline" appear within 2 s

Title: Automatic sync on reconnect
Steps: 1. Untick Simulate offline
Expected result: Outbox empties within 5 s; records turn Synced; no manual action needed

Title: Changes arrive from another device
Preconditions: Two devices logged in (normal + incognito window)
Steps: 1. Device 2 edits a record  2. Device 1 clicks Sync now (or waits 20 s)
Expected result: Device 1 shows Device 2's change

Title: Retries never create duplicates
Steps: 1. Admin: failure rate 50%, mode After processing, Apply  2. On a field worker device go offline, create 5 records, reconnect  3. Wait until synced  4. Set failure rate Off
Expected result: Exactly 5 new records on every device; Admin "Duplicates ignored" count above 0

Title: Sync status badges
Steps: 1. Go offline, edit a record  2. Reconnect
Expected result: Tag goes Not synced → Synced; pill shows waiting count while offline

Title: Different fields merge automatically
Steps: 1. Device 1 offline: change Priority of record X  2. Device 2 online: change Location of record X  3. Device 1 reconnects
Expected result: Record X has both the new Priority and the new Location on both devices; no conflict

Title: Edit wins over delete
Steps: 1. Device 1 offline: edit Notes of record Y  2. Device 2 online: delete record Y  3. Device 1 reconnects
Expected result: Record Y comes back with Device 1's notes and a "Restored" tag on both devices

Title: Manual conflict resolution
Steps: 1. Device 1 offline: change Notes of record Z  2. Device 2 online: change Notes of record Z  3. Device 1 reconnects  4. Open Conflicts, choose Combine, edit, Save combined version
Expected result: Conflict shows both versions side by side; after saving, both devices show the combined notes

Title: Open conflicts are counted
Steps: 1. Look at the Conflicts tab
Expected result: Red badge shows the number of open conflicts; disappears after resolving

Title: Sync history
Steps: 1. Open Sync activity
Expected result: History table lists recent pushes/pulls with counts per device

Title: Admin dashboard is admin-only
Steps: 1. Log in as Asha: no Admin tab  2. Log in as Admin: open Admin
Expected result: Asha has no Admin tab (API returns 403); Admin sees tiles, devices, last 7 days

Title: Load test
Steps: 1. Run npm run test:load
Expected result: 0 errors; record p50/p95 (target p95 < 500 ms)

Title: CSV import with validation
Steps: 1. Import sample-data/import-sample.csv  2. Import sample-data/import-with-errors.csv
Expected result: First: 15 imported. Second: 3 imported, 4 skipped with reasons listed

Title: Logout warns about unsynced changes
Steps: 1. Make a change  2. Click Log out
Expected result: Warning shows the number of unsynced changes; Cancel keeps you logged in with data intact

Title: Server reset is detected
Steps: 1. Stop server, npm run reset, npm start  2. Click Sync now
Expected result: Toast "The server was reset, so this device reloaded its data"; list shows the fresh 24 records

Title: Durability test
Steps: 1. Run npm run test:durability
Expected result: PASS: every device matches the server; 0 records lost; 0 operations applied twice

Title: Edit the same notes back and forth on phone and laptop
Preconditions: Phone app and laptop browser logged in, both online
Steps: 1. Laptop edits Notes, phone edits Notes of the same record within a few seconds  2. Repeat 3 times without resolving  3. Laptop edits once more, then phone clicks Keep this edit
Expected result: Only one open conflict card showing the newest values; step 3 shows "record changed again" with the latest version instead of overwriting it

Title: Built-in vs real PostgreSQL
Steps: 1. `npm start` → Admin → Database tile  2. Start with DATABASE_URL (README §5)
Expected result: Tile shows PGlite, then PostgreSQL; sample data loads in both

Title: Live update
Steps: 1. Two windows side by side  2. Edit a record in one
Expected result: Other window updates within 1 s without Sync now; green live dot visible

Title: Clean-up forces resync
Steps: 1. Admin → retention 1 day  2. Delete a record; wait / run clean-up  3. A device that was offline reconnects
Expected result: That device downloads everything again and matches the server

Title: Live charts and /metrics
Steps: 1. Admin → Live charts  2. Open http://localhost:3000/metrics
Expected result: Charts show the last 60 minutes; metrics page lists syncsafe_* counters

Title: Stay logged in
Steps: 1. Set ACCESS_TTL_SECONDS=30 and restart  2. Use the app for 2 minutes
Expected result: No logout; requests keep working (token refreshed automatically)

Title: Remote sign-out + erase
Steps: 1. Admin → All devices → Sign out + erase the Incognito window's device
Expected result: That window returns to login within 30 s; its records are gone

Title: Viewer is read-only
Steps: 1. Log in as Guest  2. Try to edit
Expected result: Read-only banner; no Save or New record buttons; API returns 403 if forced

Title: Separate teams
Steps: 1. Log in as nurse@rivervalley.test
Expected result: Only 3 River Valley records; none from Demo Team

Title: Encrypted on the device
Steps: 1. Reload the page  2. Enter the wrong password, then the right one  3. DevTools → Application → IndexedDB → syncsafe-v2
Expected result: Wrong password refused; right one unlocks offline; stored values are unreadable ciphertext

Title: Photo upload resumes
Steps: 1. Offline: add a 3 MB photo  2. Admin fault 50% after processing  3. Reconnect, wait, fault off
Expected result: Photo reaches the server once and opens on the other device; Sync activity shows its progress

Title: GPS and map
Steps: 1. Editor → Use my location  2. Map tab  3. Tap the map → New record here
Expected result: Pin at your location coloured by status; new record has those coordinates

Title: Custom form fields
Steps: 1. Admin → Add field "Water source" (choice list: Well, Tap)  2. Mark required, save  3. New record without it
Expected result: Save blocked with "Water source is required"; the field appears in the Excel export

Title: Assignment and overdue
Steps: 1. Meera assigns a record to Asha, due yesterday
Expected result: Asha's bell shows it; record shows "overdue" in red; Reports lists it

Title: Exports
Steps: 1. Reports → CSV, Excel, PDF
Expected result: Three files download (phone: share sheet); Excel has Summary and Records sheets

Title: History and undo
Steps: 1. Edit a record twice  2. History → restore version 1
Expected result: New version with version 1's values on both devices

Title: Partial sync
Steps: 1. Sync activity → Keep "Assigned to me" → Apply
Expected result: Only records assigned to or created by you remain on that device

Title: Notes merge (CRDT)
Steps: 1. Admin → Notes rule = Merge  2. Both devices offline type different sentences in the same notes  3. Both reconnect
Expected result: Both sentences present on both devices; no conflict card

Title: Suggestions and duplicates
Steps: 1. New record titled "Urgent: injured child"  2. New record titled "Hand pump inspection Ward 4"
Expected result: ✨ suggests High priority with the reason; duplicate warning names the existing record

Title: Languages
Steps: 1. Switch to తెలుగు then हिन्दी
Expected result: Every label, button and message changes language

Title: GitHub build
Steps: 1. Push to main  2. Actions → both workflows green  3. Releases → latest
Expected result: SyncSafe.apk and two zips attached; APK installs over the previous build
